title: Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts Deductible Rule for Waiting-Period Re-decision Lines
content:
**Rule.** On a waiting-period re-decision line of a Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts contract, the deductible taken follows the visit's own record.
1. Where the repair order was written at the store that sold the contract, and the coverage level carries the disappearing deductible, no deductible is taken.
2. Where that is not so, and the coverage level takes its deductible once per repair visit, the deductible taken is the deductible chosen at sale less the contract deductibles the store already billed the holder on that repair order, never below zero.
3. Otherwise, the deductible chosen at sale is taken once.

The store of the repair order, and the contract deductibles it billed the holder on it, are read from the store's repair-order lines in the Service Accounts and Repair Orders records.

| Coverage level | Disappearing deductible at the selling store | Deductible taken once per repair visit |
|---|---|---|
| Kessler Shield Powertrain, Powertrain Plus | no | no (once per component group repaired) |
| Kessler Shield Select, Preferred, Exclusionary, Exclusionary Wrap | yes | yes |

**Worked cases (hypothetical deductible chosen at sale of 250).**
- A Kessler Shield Select repair order written at the selling store: none taken.
- A Kessler Shield Preferred repair order at another store, on which the store already billed the holder 100.00 of contract deductible: 250 less 100.00, so 150.00 is taken.
- The same with 300.00 already billed: 250 less 300.00 is below zero, so 0.00 is taken.
- A Kessler Shield Powertrain Plus repair order at any store: 250 taken once.
